instructions.description: Line a plate with a paper towel. Place a medium non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add canola oil. Let oil heat, 5 minutes. Add shrimp to hot pan and sear until shrimp reach a minimum internal temperature of 145 degrees, 2-3 minutes per side. Test oil temperature by adding a pinch of flour mixture to it.
